keeps.why: The current pin 46.5230,-87.9870 is on the park entry road beside US-41 at the day-use entrance, ~300 m NE of the campsites. The modern campground is two long loops (OSM service ways 280671892 = Loop 1, 280671894 = Loop 2; RVs on the pads in Esri imagery at 0.4 m) spanning about 46.5196-46.5217 / -87.9910 to -87.9868; 46.5208,-87.9893 sits between the two loops by the central toilet/shower building. Elevation 486 m is Open-Meteo at the new pin (stored 478 m was the entrance's). Waterfront: the stored waterfront_evidence is a bucket reference to the June 2026 MI sweep that names no coordinate or artifact, so it describes neither pin. At the new pin the 'not waterfront' call still holds: the loops' west ends (DNR camp map sites 41-43 and 109-112, the ones closest to the lake) sit ~40-50 m east of the Lake Michigamme shore behind a continuous wooded strip (Esri frame at 46.5210,-87.9893), and north of Loop 1 is the day-use lawn, pavilion and beach. Suggested replacement evidence: 'Esri World Imagery at 46.5210,-87.9893 + DNR campground map (VanRiperCampMap.pdf): Loop 1/2 west ends (sites 41-43, 109-112) ~40-50 m from Lake Michigamme behind a continuous treeline; the open shore to the NW is the day-use beach and lawn -> not waterfront.'

adds.name: Van Riper State Park - Peshekee River Rustic Campground
adds.note: Rustic campground of Van Riper State Park, south of US-41 in the woods just west of the modern campground, across a small creek from it, beside the park's boat launch and the Cully Gage camper cabin on Lake Michigamme. It is reached by the park road from the contact station, past the modern campground's loops. Despite the name it is not on the Peshekee River, which enters the lake about 1 km to the northwest on the far side of the highway, where the park's riverside rustic cabin and group camp are. --Claude
adds.inclusion_evidence: michigan.gov/recsearch/parks/vanriper (read 2026-10-25): 'Van Riper Peshekee River Rustic Campground ... The rustic campground has many sites set in the woods near the modern campground', 'Number of sites: 39', reservable at 800-447-2757 or online; DNR campground map VanRiperCampMap.pdf: rustic sites on a drive-in double loop off the park road; MiDNRReservations (Van Riper State Park, resourceLocationId -2147483341, map 'Rustic' -2147483022 'Sites 1-40, Camper Cabin', read 2026-10-25): 39 campsites 2R-40R, no electric/water/sewer; allowed equipment 'Trailer or RV up to 25'' at only 6 sites (7R, 10R, 19R, 21R, 30R, 39R; posted site lengths 33, 65, 26, 38, 35 and 25 ft), 'Trailer or RV up to 20'' at 28, no trailer or RV at 5 (12R, 14R tents only; 16R, 20R, 22R tents/truck camper); one pull-through (36R, 20-ft limit). So a 23-ft motorhome fits only those 6 sites; no posted trailer restriction on the access road (the park road from the contact station).
adds.waterfront_evidence: Esri World Imagery frames at 46.5197,-87.9935 and 46.5192,-87.9915 (0.3-0.5 m) + OSM (loop ways 280671895/280671898, stream 1534687439, Peshekee River 145350995) + DNR campground map + MiDNRReservations 'Rustic' map (every site 'Distance to Beach: More than 200 feet'): sites are under continuous forest canopy; the Peshekee River is ~1.1 km NW across the Lake Michigamme bay, the railroad and US-41; the nearest water is the lake ~100-130 m north of the NW sites (36R-40R) behind woods and the boat-launch road and parking lot, and an unnamed creek ~90 m east of the eastern sites (16R-21R) through dense forest -> not waterfront.

separation: The site loops are ~165 m apart (rustic inner loop's NE side 46.5189,-87.9915 to modern Loop 2's SW tip 46.5203,-87.9909), separated by an unnamed creek and a wooded strip; the two pins are ~320 m apart. Both are reached through the park's one entrance and contact station (County Road AKE off US-41): the modern loops hang off their own road just inside it, while the rustic campground is on the outer park road that continues west over the creek to the rustic loop and the boat launch (County Road IAJ from Champion also meets that road at the boat launch, per OSM). Distinct campgrounds (separate booking map, fee schedule, toilets) on separate roads, but adjacent and far under the ~1 km split guide.
